question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**which**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage concludes by describing time management as a skill.
 
• The word to fill the blank should introduce a relative clause that describes the skill.
 
• "Which" is the correct relative pronoun to refer to a skill.
 
• The other options are not appropriate for referring to a skill in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Effective time management is (1) crucial__ for success. By prioritising tasks, individuals can enhance (2) __**productivity **__and reduce stress. Planning allows for a balance (3) __**between **__work and personal life. Studies show that those who manage their time (4) __**effectively **__are more likely to achieve their goals. It is a skill (5) __**which **__positively impacts both professional and personal aspects of life.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Those** (वे): "Those" is a demonstrative pronoun used to refer to people, not a skill.
 
• **What** (क्या): "What" is an interrogative pronoun or a relative pronoun that introduces a noun clause, not an adjective clause describing a skill.
 
• **Whereby** (जिसके द्वारा): "Whereby" is an adverb that means "by which" or "in accordance with which," and does not fit the context of describing a skill.
